history.overview: The Rifts mark the point where Discord energy has fully ruptured the Bloodfields.

timeline.name: First Ruptures
timeline.description: Discord energy began tearing open small rifts in the terrain.

timeline.name: Core Formation
timeline.description: Major rift cores formed, destabilizing the surrounding area.

timeline.name: Muramite Exploitation
timeline.description: Muramite forces attempted to harness rifts for strategic advantage.

timeline.name: Resistance Collapse Efforts
timeline.description: Resistance agents launched operations to collapse or disrupt rifts.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: The Rifts remain highly unstable and extremely dangerous.
